about: Tambocor (flecainide), by brand name only, is supplied ten times from December 2025 to September 2026 to a 69-year-old woman.
Flecatab (flecainide) is supplied four times from January to April 2026 to a 73-year-old man, in the middle of a 14-month history.
Betaloc (metoprolol), a beta-blocker that the source suggests as an alternative, is supplied throughout and no propafenone or flecainide is supplied, so the criterion is not met.
